detailed_description: Markdown to Slides converts pasted Markdown-style text into a simple browser-side slide deck. Slides are split on lines containing only `---`; lines beginning with `# ` or `## ` become slide titles, bullet lines beginning with `- ` or `* ` are shown as bullets, and `Notes:` or `Speaker Notes:` lines are displayed as speaker notes for the current slide. You can load a sample, choose light, dark, or gradient themes, convert the text, navigate slides with buttons or arrow keys, open a fullscreen presentation mode, and export the generated slides as a single HTML file. The tool does not import `.md` files, use Reveal.js or Deck.js, parse YAML front matter, upload custom CSS, provide code highlighting, generate PDFs, or build automatic tables of contents.
usage_steps: Paste slide text into the Markdown textarea or click Load Sample.
Separate slides with a line containing only `---`.
Choose the light, dark, or gradient theme.
Click Convert to create the slide preview.
Navigate slides with the previous and next buttons, use presentation mode, or export the deck as HTML.
usage_examples: Turn a short outline separated by `---` into a browser-side slide preview.
Create a simple bullet-list presentation with light, dark, or gradient styling.
Add `Notes:` text to keep speaker notes visible below the current slide.
Export a small generated presentation as an HTML file for local use.
